target.title: fix(qa): Mantis before-after exits when a lane command stalls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where QA operators running `openclaw qa mantis before-after` could have the entire before/after evidence run wait forever when a baseline or candidate lane command stalled. The first reachable command, `git worktree add`, and the later install, build, and QA commands were spawned without any deadline or process-tree cleanup.

## Why This Change Was Made

Each Mantis lane command now uses the public process runtime with a 30-minute per-command deadline and process-tree termination, while continuing to stream stdout and stderr to the invoking terminal. The budget matches the existing QA test-file command budget. No CLI flag, config key, schema, dependency, or protocol surface is added.

## User Impact

Mantis before/after runs now fail with a command-specific timeout instead of hanging indefinitely, and subprocesses that ignore graceful termination cannot remain behind after the failure.

## Evidence

The failure was reproduced against the original runner, then verified through the production entry with real parent/descendant processes, focused tests, and static boundary checks.

### Before-fix reproduction

The regression test was added first and run against the original bare-`spawn` runner under an outer six-second deadline:

```text
$ timeout --foreground 6s node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.test.ts -t 'times out a stuck lane command'
exit=124

The test never settled before the outer deadline.
```

### After-fix real process-tree proof

This invoked the production `runMantisBeforeAfter` entry with a real executable `git` shim. Both the shim and its descendant ignored `SIGTERM` and stayed active until the production deadline path terminated their process group:

```text
[mantis deadline proof] elapsed_ms=1348 error="git worktree add --detach -- /tmp/mantis-deadline-proof-PlsPvP/.artifacts/qa-e2e/mantis/proof/worktrees/baseline baseline-ref timed out after 1000ms" parent_alive=false descendant_alive=false
```

### Focused regression and adjacent CLI tests

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/cli.test.ts
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests       64 passed (64)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 11.99s
```

The real process-tree regression also passed three consecutive focused runs before the final test budget was raised from 250ms to the less timing-sensitive 1500ms used by the existing sibling process-group test.

### Static and boundary checks

```text
$ oxfmt --check extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ oxlint extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.test.ts
exit=0

$ node scripts/check-extension-plugin-sdk-boundary.mjs
No extension plugin-sdk boundary violations found.
Baseline matches (0 entries).

$ git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
exit=0
```

### Source and process-runtime contract audit

- Reachable entry chain: `extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/cli.ts:225` -> `extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/cli.runtime.ts:32` -> `extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.ts:552` -> each `runLane` command.
- Owner boundary: the QA Lab plugin imports only the public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/process-runtime` and `number-runtime` facades; the extension boundary checker is green.
- I/O contract: `src/process/exec-runner.ts:68` inherits stdin, pipes stdout/stderr, invokes `onOutputChunk` for streaming, and permits `outputCapture: "discard"` so the wrapper does not retain command output in memory.
- Timeout result contract: the same runner returns structured `termination`, `code`, and `signal`; the Mantis adapter reports a command-specific timeout and preserves the previous nonzero-exit/signal error shape.
- Process-tree contract: `src/process/exec-termination.ts:15` owns graceful and forced cleanup. POSIX commands run in a detached process group; Windows uses `taskkill /T`; both use the shared 300ms grace from `src/process/exec-spawn.ts:7` and settle cleanup before returning. Windows graceful/forced tree termination is covered at `src/process/exec.windows.test.ts:400`.
- Sibling budget: `extensions/qa-lab/src/test-file-scenario-runner.ts:87` already uses the same 30-minute per-command default. The new Mantis regression at `extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.test.ts:263` supplies the POSIX real-process-tree proof.

`check-changed` passed conflict-marker, max-lines, changelog-attribution, wildcard-export, duplicate-coverage, dependency-pin, formatting, Plugin SDK API baseline, deprecated-API, plugin-boundary, package-patch, and test-temp checks. Its extension typecheck was blocked in the shared local dependency installation by three `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` errors outside this diff. Canonical CI for the exact base SHA `ec998a0f3fc8bd5a54b92e9a826fb37e157dec61` is green, so PR CI's clean dependency environment is the authoritative typecheck follow-up.
